Dear Hiring Committee,


I am applying for the Data Analyst position at Lasso Informatics. I believe I am an ideal candidate for the position, as I possess the required statistical expertise, and ample experience working with observational and experimental data.

My experience and skills align closely with the requirements of the role. In my role as postdoctoral fellow at CRCHUM, I work in clinical research using big health data (electronic health records) composed of millions of observations. I am in charge of the whole project lifecycle: obtaining raw data, developing data processing pipelines, running statistical analyses, creating visualizations that convey critical information from complex data, and writing manuscripts for publication in high-impact journals.


In my doctoral training, I worked primarily with experimental data. Here, because I was in charge of designing my own experiments, I gained valuable experience with statistical methods of power analysis, randomization, and statistical methods to analyse longitudinal data (generalized additive models). Working in clinical and preclinical research has allowed me to  develop strong organizational and communication skills and work with interdisciplinary teams composed of biomedical researchers, clinicians, students, and technical staff. My publication record attests to my adaptability to different research environments, and my role as someone that seeks to contribute to the success of the team and the timely completion of all milestones. I believe Lasso Informatics is a company where I can professionally grow doing what I love: work in intellectually-stimulating and relevant research projects.


Thank you for considering my application. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications further.

Sincerely,
